No dataset on data.medicaid.gov or data.cms.gov contains the Medicaid Drug Utilization Review (DUR) annual survey responses (fee-for-service or managed care). CMS publishes those state responses as report documents on www.medicaid.gov, which is outside the allowed hosts and was not contacted. No state answer about antipsychotic or stimulant oversight in children was fetched, and none is recorded or inferred here.
caveats: This file contains NO state responses. 'states' is empty on purpose; do not show any state as having or lacking an antipsychotic or stimulant monitoring programme on the basis of this file.
The catalogue search API matches substrings: its hits for 'DUR survey' and 'foster' are unrelated datasets (listed under 'searched' so that can be checked).
'related_but_not_equivalent' names CMS datasets that measure outcomes of antipsychotic prescribing in children. They are quality rates, not a record of state oversight policy, and were not extracted.
